query: Which provenance tools (nearest-neighbor in which embedding spaces, influence functions, representer points, membership inference) best attribute generative outputs and what are known failure modes?

response.query: Which provenance tools (nearest-neighbor in which embedding spaces, influence functions, representer points, membership inference) best attribute generative outputs and what are known failure modes?
response.answer: Representer points and influence functions best attribute generative outputs, while nearest-neighbor and membership inference have known failure modes in complex, high-dimensional data.
